text: I keep adding kurtis and dresses to my wishlist but never checkout. Prices feel too high and I wait for a sale that never feels good enough. Wishlist is full, purchases almost zero.
Love browsing and shortlisting shoes, but I hesitate to buy because size charts are confusing. Saved items sit in wishlist for weeks while I compare fit reviews.
Wishlist is useful for later, but I postpone purchase because returns are stressful for ethnic wear. Unsure about quality until I see fabric in person.
I shortlist 8-10 outfits then leave the app to compare on Amazon and Flipkart. Wishlist becomes a bookmark, not purchase intent. Need clearer price drop alerts.
Saved wedding guest dresses for an occasion next month. Still thinking, not sure about styling and whether reviews can be trusted for colour accuracy.
Item was in my wishlist for ages. When I finally decided to buy, size M was out of stock. Delayed decision plus availability killed the conversion.
I bookmark everything I like while scrolling. Most wishlist items are passive saves for later inspiration, not something I plan to purchase soon.
Hesitate on wishlist sneakers because delivery estimates are long and return pickup is unreliable in my area. Logistics friction stops me from buying.
Before buying from wishlist I read dozens of reviews and still feel unsure. Fake-looking reviews make me postpone purchase again and again.
App wishlist is great for planning outfits within budget. I wait for coupon codes and price drops; without discount I rarely convert saved items.
